notes.title: upcoming patch 2.0 & new game!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 2.0 coming soon![/h1]

Some of you already noticed a few changes ingame: That's because some parts of the new major patch are already included in the game. The full patch and patchnotes will be released in the upcoming weeks! New artworks, new languages, features and alot of improvements.

[h1]Upcoming relaxing coop-game![/h1]
We are excited to announce our upcoming game Pixel With Your Friends! A cozy casual game you can play with friends! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1391200/Pixel_With_Your_Friends

Pixel With Your Friends is a color-by-numbers game, you have to restore paintings for a museum. Release-date: 2024-08-02

Every wishlist is appreciated and helps us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31526969/c20ad4d311cb9aa14e8a1ebfb4de1a15c9264e0f.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.9.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.9.0[/h1]

Thank you for all your feedback on [b] Puzzle With Your Friends [/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31526969/72904688ef70ef545c209410101ce4a87d0e78e3.jpg[/img]

In 1.9.0 we have 3 new artworks including one from the Pixel-Artist [url=https://twitter.com/gnomenlied]Gnomenlied[/url]


[list]
[*] 3 new artworks and achievements
[*] New sounds for better feedback
[*] You will now also receive the versus-achievement on losing
[*] The gallery now displays an icon for "in progress"-Puzzles
[*] Pieces that are already placed on the puzzle mat won't be shuffled anymore
[*] "Are you sure?" window now specifies what it is about (resetting, back to menu,..)
[*] Bug-fix: The score at the end of a versus match will always be correct on both players now
[/list]


If you have any ideas or wishes for the next patch: don't hesitate to contact me or to give feedback via F9 ingame. We also opened a discord! If you want to give us feedback there and get in touch with other players, for example to play a match, you are welcome to join us!

https://discord.com/invite/tBnfKns

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31526969/f16396b937df78205080cb09250e50693aab4dd2.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.7.0 - Artwork, bugfixes, lobby size
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.7.0[/h1]

Hello everyone! Thank you for the support you are still giving [b]Puzzle With Your Friends[/b] after all this time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31526969/72904688ef70ef545c209410101ce4a87d0e78e3.jpg[/img]

2019 (and I think every last one of us is having a hard 2020 also) was a really rough year for me, especially with the sudden death of Tassilo Rau, the head of bumblebee. I've started being self-employed under the new name "SkyCat Games". This patch was meant to be for last year and I have to apologize again for delaying it. I promise the next patch won't take as long! :)

The focus was on patching bugs - especially those which were rare but really annoying, if you encounter any bugs(feedback is also welcome!) please report them ingame via the F12-button which will automatically add a log-file to help me fix them.

[list]
[*] New artwork from Cosplay Convention Crisis! Thank you [url=https://twitter.com/thehiddenlevels]The Hidden Levels[/url]!
[*] [BETA] Lobbies are no longer limited to 2 players - this is still in beta-mode, you won't see each other mouse-cursor, if you encounter any problems please report them via f12 or contact me via Steam!
[*] "Snapping" pieces has now an increased margin for error and feels smoother
[*] You can now report bugs or give feedback ingame!
[*] You can now shuffle the pieces with collapsed menu
[*] The collapsed chat will now notify you about new messages so you don't need to keep it open all the time
[*] You can now finish a puzzle after your partner left the lobby, it will no longer pause until he comes back
[*] Bug-Fix: Sometimes a player who joined another lobby had no pieces until he shuffled
[*] Bug-Fix: Sometimes the partner's mouse position was transmitted incorrectly which caused further problems
[*] Bug-Fix: When rejoining a lobby you disconnected from the player sometimes couldn't continue the puzzle and had an infinite loading-screen
[*] Bug-Fix: Players shouldn't have different scores in the final screen of the versus-mode anymore
[/list]


If you have ideas or wishes for the next patch: don't hesitate to contact me or to give feedback via F12 ingame. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31526969/0e35d2c21bbb64a34070937e4aa6976dd35b9c45.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.6 & Giveaway: Loria! - New Artworks & italian language
notes.content:
[b] Patch 1.6 [/b]

First of all I've got to apologize for the long time without any updates, this project is mostly a 1-man project and I couldn't work on the title as much as I wanted. This update is the first update in quite a while, the next one will be in the very near future with features like saving your jigsaws (so you wont need to solve it in one go), the "Split"-Mode and more.

Today's patch mostly includes 3 new artworks, italian language and bugfixes. The awesome artist [url=https://sanny-sanary.jimdo.com/]Sanny Sanary[/url] drew 2 awesome artworks that are called "Emerald-Huntress" and "Azure-Mage". 

The third artwork is from the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/946660/Loria/]Loria[/url], that already provided a picture in the past, this time it's an interesting artwork that definitely is one of the more challenging artworks in this game. The developer also provided me with 2 keys to give away here! 

[b]How to join the giveaway?[/b]
1. Post a comment under this post
2. Wishlist (or own) Loria! I think this is the least we should do to support a developer that provides keys for a giveaway!

The giveaway will run until the 30th of december!


Edit: The giveaway is over! Winners are: .45 ACP  and Aetnaria ! Congratulations! :)

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31526969/0e35d2c21bbb64a34070937e4aa6976dd35b9c45.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31526969/723a9c7c299ccfb7a6bec03ae504cf14d64e0660.png[/img][/url]

Greetings,
Stromsky

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - New Artworks, Chinese & Dutch! Promotion still ongoing!
notes.content:
[b] Patch 1.3 [/b]

Thank you everyone for all your feedback and kind words! Be sure that there will be a lot of patches with new features, modes and artworks in the future!

The promotion (get a second key after buying the game and playing 2 hours) is still ongoing since there are still a lot of keys left!

Broad overview over the patch:
[list]
[*] New artworks from Ironward, Lanze Games and the artist Isabeau Backhaus  have been added to the game! 
[*] The game is now available in the languages chinese and dutch! 
[*] You can now hide the chat and menu (by using the small arrow beside them)
[*] Level-maximum has been increased from 50 to 99
[*] De-Syncs in multiplayer mostly have been solved, I'm aware there are still some small inconsistencies but there shouldn't be any biggers problems anymore. If you encounter any problem, please contact me!
[*] Snapping pieces together or putting them into place should be easier than before
[*] The timer & mode display have been moved and should no longer block either the puzzle nor the preview-picture

If you have feedback or any problems, don't hesitate to post them in the forums or to contact me!
